options.source:
&fn-enchant
  args: [ "<x>" ]
  return:
    not-supported:
      condition: "!supported"
      name: "{$sep}[{$e}Not Supported{$sep}] {$es}<x>"
      sound: BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_BASS
      lore: |
        {$e}This enchantment is not
        supported in your current server
        version.
    enabled:
      condition: enabled
      name: "{$enabled} <x>{$colon} {$s}%roman@level% {$sep}({$s}%level%{$sep})"
      glow: true
      lore: |
        {$sep}Left-click to change level
        {$sep}Right-click to remove
    else:
      name: "{$disabled} <x>"
      lore: |
        {$sep}Left-click to add enchant
